description: A box with its own scrolling and a thin, rounded scrollbar that looks the same in every browser. Give it a fixed height (or width for horizontal scrolling).

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: For a row of photos or chips that scrolls sideways. Add <ScrollBar orientation="horizontal" />.

parts.root: The scrolling box. A vertical scrollbar is added automatically.

props.className: Set the height/width here, e.g. h-72.
